# Runs 6-7: per-tone onsets (sdh_onset matched filter) + SdH FFT in 1/B, read against the FS-count model.
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.home() / "measurement_env/hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count"))
import fs_count_b0 as fsm
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset

I_BIAS = 10e-9
FS_OHM = 50e-6 / I_BIAS
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12.5, 4.6))
for a, (i, side, n12, blo) in zip(ax, ((6, "electron", +3.2, 1.2), (7, "hole", -1.2, 0.75))):
    r = run(i)
    B, R = r.col("magnet_field"), r.col("sr1_X") / I_BIAS
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[o], R[o]
    FL = float(luttinger_frequency(abs(n12) * 1e16))
    on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=FS_OHM)
    print(f"--- run {i} ({side}, n = {n12:+.1f}e12): F_L = {FL:.1f} T, onset_b = {on.onset_b:.2f} T"
          f"{' (censored: carrying tone persists to the record low edge)' if any(t.censored for t in on.tones) else ''} ---")
    for t in on.tones:
        if not t.marginal:
            print(f"  tone F = {t.freq:6.2f} T  (F/F_L = {t.freq/FL:.3f}, onset {t.onset_b:.2f} T"
                  + (", censored" if t.censored else "")
                  + (f", ratio-tagged harmonic_of {t.harmonic_of:.2f}" if t.harmonic_of else "") + ")")
    f, spec = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(blo, 10.0), nfft=4096, log=False)
    sp = spec[0] / spec[0].max()
    a.plot(f, sp, lw=0.9, label=f"FFT, {blo}-10 T")
    a.axvline(FL, color="k", ls=":", label=f"F_L = {FL:.1f} T (scale 1)")
    _, orbs = fsm.abab_fs(n12 * 1e16)
    for F, kF in orbs:
        a.axvline(F, color="tab:red", ls="--", lw=0.8)
    a.plot([], [], color="tab:red", ls="--", lw=0.8, label="ABAB model pair (scale 1)")
    a.set(xlim=(0, 1.9 * FL), xlabel="F (T)", ylabel="FFT amp (norm)",
          title=f"run {i} — {side} (dF = {1/(1/blo - 0.1):.1f} T)")
    a.legend(fontsize=8)
fig.suptitle("sdh-spot-check FFTs vs tetralayer FS-count model — vti-02, D = 0")
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# Luttinger / template arithmetic on the matched-filter frequencies:
print()
for side, fl_, light, heavy, extra in (("electron n=+3.2e12", 33.09, 7.11, 22.08, 29.47),
                                       ("hole    n=-1.2e12", 12.41, 4.72, 6.59, 12.34)):
    tot = light + heavy
    print(f"{side}: pair {light:.2f} + {heavy:.2f} = {tot:.2f} T -> global scale {tot/fl_:.2f} vs F_L; "
          f"partition {light/tot:.2f}/{heavy/tot:.2f}; extra tone {extra:.2f} T = {extra/tot:.2f} x pair-sum "
          f"(breakdown/sum-tone candidate at scaled F_L)")
n_eff = 3.2 * 0.88
_, orbs = fsm.abab_fs(n_eff * 1e16)
Fs = [F for F, _ in orbs]
print(f"model check at n_eff = {n_eff:.1f}e12 (scale 0.88): ABAB pair {Fs[0]:.1f}/{Fs[1]:.1f} T "
      f"(partition {Fs[0]/sum(Fs):.2f}/{Fs[1]/sum(Fs):.2f}) vs measured 7.11/22.08 (0.24/0.76)")

**Read (spot-check level, per `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count` Step 3):**

- **Electron side (run 6, n = +3.2×10¹², F_L = 33.1 T):** a two-tone set 7.11 / 22.08 T whose sum 29.19 T sits at **0.88 × F_L** — inside the lever-arm scale prior — with partition **0.24 / 0.76** against the ABAB model's 0.21 / 0.79 at n_eff = 2.8×10¹². The 29.47 T tone ≈ 1.01 × pair-sum is the **breakdown / sum-tone candidate at scaled F_L** (symmetry-allowed for ABAB, expected per the investigation). 14.08 T = 1.98 × 7.11 is a true 2nd harmonic.
- **Harmonic-screen caveat:** `sdh_onset` ratio-tags 22.08 and 29.47 as harmonics of 7.11 at **3.11×** and **4.15×** — not integer multiples (3× = 21.3 T, 4× = 28.4 T, both off by ≫ the matched-filter resolution), and dropping 22.08 breaks the Luttinger partition sum. Per the investigation's Luttinger-aware screen these are kept as candidate fundamentals; the **fan's n-dependence decides** (a harmonic tracks k·f_light(n), a real pocket tracks its own Onsager curve, a breakdown sum tone tracks F_L, linear in n).
- **Hole side (run 7, n = −1.2×10¹², F_L = 12.4 T):** close, balanced pair 4.72 / 6.59 T, sum 11.31 T → scale **0.91**, partition **0.42 / 0.58** vs model 0.43 / 0.57 — exactly the predicted near-CNP ABAB exception regime (tones close and balanced), with an intermodulation-rich set above (8.53 ≈ 2×6.59 − 4.72; 12.34 ≈ pair-sum). Consistent, not independently decisive.
- **ABCA disfavored at both spots:** no lone singleton at F_L — both sides resolve a partner tone well below F_L plus a sum-tone candidate. Two independent global-scale estimates (0.88, 0.91) agree within the prior.

**Verdict at this stage:** consistent-with **ABAB** on the measured contact pair (B_1–B_2 region), pending the fan's branch-trajectory test (dual overlay ABAB vs trilayer ML+BL, per Verify). **Fan goes to the electron side** — it reaches n = +3.27×10¹² where the templates separate; the hole side is capped at −1.27×10¹² inside the exception regime.

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side (`landau-fan-vti`), D = 0, n +0.4→+3.2×10¹², B 1.2→10 T

> **05:31** · landau-fan-vti e-side: D=0, n +3.2->+0.4e12 (81 cols, run-5 cal), B 1.2->10 T uniform-1/B (74 rows, d(1/B)=0.0100), sr1 100 uV, fast\_delay 1.8 s (6tau); ends 10 T, gates parked 0 · **ETA ~10:31** (≈5h)

Spot checks (runs 6–7, ana cells 14–17) resolved an ABAB-consistent constellation on **both** sides: electron pair 7.11 / 22.08 T summing to 0.88·F_L with a sum tone at 29.47 T; hole pair 4.72 / 6.59 T at scale 0.91. The fan is the investigation's Step 4 decision measurement: per-column FFT → F(n) branch trajectories against the model curves (ABAB **and** trilayer ML+BL dual overlay), the Luttinger partition across density, and the F_L-tone origin via n-dependence (harmonics track k·f_light(n); a real pocket tracks its own Onsager curve; a breakdown sum tone tracks F_L linearly). **Electron side**: reaches n = +3.27×10¹² where the templates separate; the hole side is capped at −1.27×10¹² inside the near-CNP exception regime (already sampled by run 7). **Design (computed, cost-floored):**

- **B rows**: uniform 1/B, **1.2 → 10 T, 74 rows** — Δ(1/B) = 0.0100 /T = 1/(3·F_L(n_max)) (Nyquist to 49.8 T, covers the sum tone at ≤ 33 T and the heavy tone's 2nd harmonic at 44 T); δF = 1/(1/1.2 − 1/10) = **1.36 T** → heavy-vs-sum-tone split (7.4 T measured) = 5.4·δF. `B_lo` = 1.2 T sits under the heavy tone's measured onset 1.36 T (`sdh_onset`, run 6); the light tone is censored (persists below the analyzable record) — extending lower explodes both Nyquist floors (~30 h) and the claim doesn't need it: the light tone carries 5.2 periods in-window at n_max.
- **n columns**: **+3.2 → +0.4×10¹², 81 pts** (Δn = 0.035×10¹²) — 3.3 samples per LL-ray period at B_lo (g = 4), above the prefer-3 floor. Below n ≈ +0.4 the CNP flank's R×MR blows the fixed-sensitivity corner.
- **Resolvability floor, stated**: with this window the light partner is a clean ≥5-period tone only for f_light ≳ 6.8 T (n ≳ 2.8×10¹² per the model); below that it's detectable-but-broad, and near its model minimum (n ≈ 0.8×10¹², pocket empties) invisible. The heavy branch + partition sum + sum-tone trajectory carry the low-n end of the claim.
- **Sensitivity**: fixed 100 µV (10 kΩ FS). Worst corner low-n × high-B: ~330 Ω CNP anchor × ~8 MR ≈ 2.6 kΩ = 26% FS (run 6 high-n columns sit at 3–5% FS, SdH amplitudes 5–90 Ω). Ascending fan ⇒ clip risk arrives late — I watch the per-row `hi/fs` stats and abort before a rail corrupts the low-n columns.
- **Price** (calibrated on run 5: fast-axis overhead 0.10 s/pt, row gap 5.8 s): position 0→1.2 T ≈ 9 min + ramp 1.2→10 T ≈ 64 min + 74 rows × (81 × 1.9 s + ~4 s) ≈ 194 min → **4.5 h**, headline **≈ 5 h** with the session's 5–10% overrun margin. Ends at **10 T, gates parked at 0** — the LK mass ladder / firming cuts ride the magnet down.
- **Checkpoints**: first rows (~15 min — signal/sensitivity/leakage, R(n) profile vs runs 5–6 anchors); ~3 T (row ~50, ≈2.6 h) and ~6 T (row ~66, ≈3.7 h) — partial per-column FFT on landed rows: tone set forming, clip watch; abort/adjust calls priced there. `hera-watch` armed on `data --next --follow`.

# === Landau fan, electron side (`landau-fan-vti`): D = 0, n +3.2 -> +0.4 e12 (81 cols) x B 1.2 -> 10 T uniform-1/B (74 rows) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages
from hera.analysis import field_invB

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.linspace(3.2, 0.4, 81)               # 1e12 cm^-2, fast axis: high n first (low-R end at row start)
D0 = 0.0                                        # V/nm
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.full_like(n_vec, D0), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, \
    (Vtgs.min(), Vtgs.max(), Vbgs.min(), Vbgs.max())
print(f"fast axis: n = {n_vec[0]:+.2f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.2f} e12 at D = {D0} (dn = {abs(n_vec[1]-n_vec[0]):.3f}e12); "
      f"Vtg {Vtgs.min():+.4f}..{Vtgs.max():+.4f} V, Vbg {Vbgs.min():+.4f}..{Vbgs.max():+.4f} V")

# --- slow axis: uniform in 1/B (per-column SdH-FFT fan), ascending from where the magnet sits (0 T -> 1.2 T position) ---
B_vec = field_invB(1.2, 10.0, 74)               # d(1/B) = 0.0100 /T <= 1/(3*F_L(3.2e12) = 33.1 T); Nyquist 49.8 T
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
print(f"slow axis: {len(B_vec)} rows, {B_vec[0]:.2f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.2f} T uniform 1/B; "
      f"d(1/B) = {abs(1/B_vec[0] - 1/B_vec[1]):.4f} /T; dF = {1/(1/B_vec[0] - 1/B_vec[-1]):.2f} T")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0, _tau = T_sample(), magnet.field(), sr1.time_constant()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan positions to 1.2 T itself), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, "
      f"tau = {_tau} s / slope {sr1.filter_slope()} dB, nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert _tau == 0.3 and k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1

FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 1.8, 1.0               # 6*tau on the fast axis (per-column-FFT fan, base recipe step 7)
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan: 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA. Worst corner is low-n x high-B:
# R(n=0.4e12, 10 T) <~ 330 Ohm (CNP D~0 anchor, runs 0-3/5) x ~8 (near-CNP MR, run 7 showed 4x) ~ 2.6 kOhm = 26% FS.
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (10 kOhm FS); sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V; drive {sr1.amplitude()} V -> 10 nA")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan-vti electron side: D = {D0} V/nm, n = +3.2 -> +0.4 e12 (81 cols, run-5 cal), "
                  f"B = 1.2 -> 10 T uniform 1/B (74 rows), sr1 100 uV, fast_delay 1.8 s (6 tau), slow_delay 1 s")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'D = {D0} V/nm, n = +3.2 to +0.4 e12 cm^-2 (81 pts), B = 1.2 to 10 T uniform 1/B (74 rows); '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; '
              f'per-column SdH-FFT fan after spot checks runs 6-7 (pair 7.11/22.08 T + sum tone, scale 0.88)')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, magnet_field, k_tg_volt, k_bg_volt, T_sample, k_tg_curr, k_bg_curr, sr0_X, sr0_P, sr1_X, sr1_P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f} V: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

try:
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs],
                     slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
finally:
    s.ramp(k_tg.volt, 0); s.ramp(k_bg.volt, 0)
# field ends at 10 T deliberately — the next step (LK ladder or firming cuts) rides it down; never re-traverse.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}) V")
